title: Measuring Harmful Representations in Scandinavian Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Probing language models with neutral templates containing female and male subjects, and evaluating the completions for harmfulness and toxicity using the lexicon-based HONEST score and the Perspective API.
Measuring the frequency of offensive completions related to homosexuality by mapping language model outputs to the 'homosexuality' category in the HurtLex lexicon.
Tracking the generation of negative stereotypes and ethnic slurs by mapping language model completions to the corresponding category in the HurtLex lexicon.
